sources.entry: Touch Bar Preview - Small application to display your designs on the Touch Bar of the new MacBook Pro.

summary.one_liner: A small macOS app that previews your image designs on the Touch Bar of a MacBook Pro by drag-and-drop.
summary.what_it_does: Touch Bar Preview is a small open source macOS app for displaying your designs on the Touch Bar of the newer MacBook Pro. You drag and drop a PNG or JPEG image into the app to preview it. The app overlays the System (ESC) button and Control Strip on the image, so the design does not need to leave room for them and is offset to align. The README says the image should be 2170px by 60px (equivalent to 1085pt by 30pt); other sizes are stretched to fit the app region. The README also mentions a link to a Touch Bar UI Kit, which the author sells, found in the app. Contributions are welcome via pull requests, and bugs or feature requests go in issues.
use_cases: preview a Touch Bar design before shipping
check touch bar mockup alignment with esc and control strip
display image on macOS Touch Bar
test Touch Bar UI layouts for MacBook Pro
design assets for Touch Bar apps
how_to_run: Download the app from the repository releases.
Drag the app into the Applications folder.
Open the app and drag and drop a PNG or JPEG image into it.
notable: Automatically overlaps the ESC system button and Control Strip so designs need no exclusion zones
caveats: Designed for the Touch Bar on newer MacBook Pro models only
Non-standard image sizes are stretched to fit
keywords: show my design on touch bar
